feature: Navigation pending — the pip, the track and the escalation screen (PR 1)
note: Every row is taken on Slow 4G, because on a local server a pending state lasts a frame and the sheet would photograph the page it landed on. The nav slot's pip is not here: it sits in the shell, outside <main>, which no verb in this runner reaches by design; probe:nav-pending presses it at both widths and measures its paint time instead. The direct-load fallback is not here either: a goto resolves at DOMContentLoaded, after the stream has replaced the screen, so the probe reads it with a frame watcher.
